items.title: How to set environment variables
items.reason: astral-sh/uv#9951 asks the same question: how to associate environment variables with a uv-created virtual environment. Its discussion recommends environment files or direnv instead of modifying virtualenv activation files.

items.title: Support .env-files
items.reason: Canonical discussion for supplying project-specific environment variables to commands. It includes a closely matching activation-time use case and established the narrower uv run environment-file behavior.

items.title: Add support for `.env` and custom env files in `uv run`
items.reason: Implemented environment-variable injection for uv run through --env-file and UV_ENV_FILE. It does not make arbitrary variables part of virtualenv activation, which is the important limitation for the new report.

related.search_scope: Searched open and closed issues and all pull-request states for exact identifiers CUDA_PATH, CUDA_HOME, and env_vars.d; literal phrases around setting environment variables; and conceptual terms including activation scripts, virtual environments, per-project variables, .env, direnv, uv shell, and Conda-style configuration. Inspected the strongest discussions and their referenced fixes. astral-sh/uv#7299 was ruled out as primarily a package-build/CUDA setup problem, while astral-sh/uv#12028 and astral-sh/uv#15095 concern build-backend variables rather than variables applied when entering an environment. astral-sh/uv#1910 concerns providing an activation command, but does not itself track declarative per-environment variables.

type_reason: astral-sh/uv#9951 is the same support question about setting variables for a uv-created virtual environment, including an attempted activation-file approach. The established guidance points to environment files/direnv; uv's source-backed native support from astral-sh/uv#8263 is limited to uv run and does not provide Conda-style activation metadata.
summary: The question duplicates astral-sh/uv#9951. Related native functionality is tracked by astral-sh/uv#1384 and implemented for uv run by astral-sh/uv#8263, but it does not automatically modify the caller's environment during virtualenv activation.
